correctness.rationale: Azimuthal invariance diagonalizes in m=-3,...,3; |d^3_{m,-2}|² gives normalized polynomial densities with cap parity m vs -m. Independently used SymPy to integrate v0=15/8(1-x²)² x², v1=10(2p-q)² q³p, v2=(5p-q)²q^4, v3=6q^5p, with p=(1+x)/2 and q=(1-x)/2; each integral over [-1,1] equals 2/7, and resulting four lambda_j match the displayed degree-seven polynomials exactly. Sum lambda0+2(lambda1+lambda2+lambda3)=7(1-c). Independently factored all six pairwise gaps; roots establish ordering a<d<e<b, where e is the extra intermediate crossing, so the stated max/min multiplet transitions and degenerate dimensions follow for every interior c. At c->1 lambda2~(7/2)(1-c), lambda0~(35/2)(1-c)^3, hence squared-energy ratio asymptotic 1/[5(1-c)^2]. Numeric checks are not substituted for exact polynomial signs.
